pinreg_r4: r4 (2026-10-15): die master is pin-registered (PR=1, tools/qwen_split/d2d_pinreg_gen.py): every functional port has one flop at its pin, placed FIRM at the pin by recipe-2 io_flop_at_pins; fixes qkd r1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP (-434 ps, all boundary paths) and qfd r1 TT -79 / FF -32.6.

pin_regs.reason: RTL is already pin-registered: d2d_pinreg_gen.py PR=1 wraps qkd_d2d_static_core with exactly one flop per functional port (FIRM at the pin via io_flop_at_pins); the link calendar is compiled --pinreg; a second synthesized pin register would add +1 cycle per port with no timing purpose

structural_change: SAFE FAN-OUT successor of 353123a8d (same outline, macros, pin faces, codec2 TXDP_K 0x03030416): every >32-load source root rebuilt as KEPT copies on the master's D net (first-edge convergent; transparent census max 32 vs 1096), reset regions spread over 12-copy families (OT_RST_COPIES_MAX 24); lockstep miter cycle-identical on the full 66-write cold sequence

safe_checklist.1_pins: PASS: RTL pin-registered (PR=1, one flop per port incl. the 6 OVL pins) + kit reset_landing 2 stages (OT_RST_LAND) on por_n/rst_n + RTL ot_rst_pipe 4 regions x 2 stages
safe_checklist.2_reach: PASS: 475.2x280.8 tile, every pin flop FIRM at its pin (io_flop_at_pins), no single-cycle wire >405 um
safe_checklist.3_fanout: waived: reset region rst_n[1] 321 loads (CTS/repair buffered; r7v closed with it, SAFE-AUDIT-KV: none blocking); no data cone >32
safe_checklist.4_depth: PASS: r7v closed TT +13.55 / FF +7.68 on the same end RTL; OVL adds a 2-bit user tag pipe and an RX start mux (registered)
safe_checklist.5_storage: PASS: slot store in 4x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512 macros; TXDP capture delay = 21/4/3/3 one-bit valid shift + SRAM-staged payload as r7v
safe_checklist.6_floorplan: PASS: macros on 43.2 lattice (as reviewed r7v), full std-cell band, outline/util as r7v (fill 0.447)
safe_checklist.7_clock: PASS: one tile root (single 475 um tile, spread 71.2/64.7 in r7v), io_hold_margin 0.030
safe_checklist.8_schedule: PASS: static calendars + compiled start lists; collision/start-while-running = calendar fault, no backpressure

reset_role_review: Only por_n/rst_n reset sequential state. host_link_reset_req is a PR-registered protocol request; phy_rst_n/fwd_link_rst_n are PR-registered protocol outputs. Restrict the compatibility regex to literal reset roles, preserving their data pin flops and landing exactly the two real resets. This fixes pre-synthesis OT_PIN_REGS refusal, not a timing failure.
